summary_en: 350,000 shares (5.7% of shares outstanding) up to ¥200M. Open-market acquisition on TSE Standard via broker account trading. June 16, 2026 to May 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: AI, Inc. (Ticker: 4388, TSE Standard) announced on June 15, 2026 a treasury stock acquisition programme authorized by board resolution under the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 350,000 ordinary shares (5.7% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥200 million. Acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange through a broker account trading arrangement. The acquisition period runs from June 16, 2026 through May 31, 2027. The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency and enhance returns to shareholders while enabling flexible capital allocation in response to business conditions. As of April 30, 2026, the company held 202,125 treasury shares against 6,102,173 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
